run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run a sweep inference benchmark across different GPU configurations using SLURM job scheduler
run_sweep_with_fixed_atoms: run an inference benchmark sweep with fixed total atom counts across multiple GPU counts
run_sweep_with_per_gpu_atoms: run an inference benchmark sweep with per-GPU atom counts that scale with GPU count
generate_scaling_plots: generate weak and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results for each model
calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
